name: gonefishin
title: gonefishin
blurb: a fishing minigame: cast a line into your own follows and moots. most catches are small fish — a real post of theirs from the last 90 days, at or below their own median engagement — but sometimes you hook a whopper, one of their all-time bangers, and have to guess which of two posts got more traction to land it before the line snaps. @spinny.bsky.social pitched it in-thread; @bisks.net gave the go-ahead.
